hero.title: Anidex
hero.subtitle: Anidex is an offline animal classification and cataloging app inspired by the Pokédex, designed for exploring biodiversity through machine learning and structured taxonomy.

features.label: Intuitive Interface
features.subtitle: Camera-first exploration experience
features.text: The main app view centers on a live camera interface with the collection sheet subtly peeking from the bottom. Flash control, photo library uploads, double-tap camera switching, and pinch-to-zoom gestures are all seamlessly integrated.

features.label: Collection View
features.subtitle: Track discovery progress
features.text: View all discovered species alongside a complete index of animals yet to be found, providing a structured overview of exploration progress.

features.label: Offline Classification
features.subtitle: Instant classification using fully on-device models
features.text: Classify and catalog animals anywhere with no network dependency. Whether in a rainforest, remote field site, or completely off the grid, Anidex delivers fast, reliable species recognition entirely on-device.

features.label: Modular Model Schema
features.subtitle: Hierarchical classification architecture
features.text: Implemented a modular CoreML classification pipeline using a taxonomy-driven hierarchy, where a top-level phylum classifier first routes the image to the appropriate class-level model, which then performs fine-grained species identification.
